During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''Sector Group''' of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. The Sector Group was comprised of 2,573 [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including five [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], nineteen [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], and 1,500 other combat craft.
